name: Dematimmo
positioning: Digital platform that runs a French social landlord's tenant-allocation committee (CALEOL), on-site or fully remote.
description: Dematimmo is a French SaaS product from Activinnov that digitizes the CALEOL — the regulated committee French social landlords must hold before allocating a home. It prepares case files pulled from the landlord's ERP, runs the committee session on-screen or fully remotely with e-signed minutes and electronic voting, and pushes the attribution result back into the ERP.
real_estate_use: A social landlord's allocation team pulls candidate case files automatically from its ERP ahead of a CALEOL session, runs the session either in person with a projection screen or fully online, records votes and e-signs the minutes, then pushes the outcome back into the ERP without re-entering data. Compliance staff use the same platform to generate attribution reports by commune, EPCI or préfecture, with traceability of every vote.
features: Automatic case-file preparation from the ERP
On-site and fully remote CALEOL sessions

use_cases.job: Run a tenant-allocation committee (CALEOL) session, on-site or remotely, with e-signed minutes
Generate auditable attribution reports by commune or préfecture for regulatory compliance
